scope: Notices shipped with Apple's Metal Shader Converter runtime (Frameworks/libmetalirconverter.dylib), used only by XeniaCore to convert Xbox 360 shaders (docs/xenios-playlist.md). The agreement and Apple's acknowledgements are the maintainer's legal dossier (docs/evidence/xenia-metal-shader-converter/README.md), fetched by URL and checked against its sizes and digests; the headers licence is XeniOS's copy. Not a declaration that redistribution is resolved: the dossier's open points (1) EA1844 vs the pinned ios-4.0.3 runtime (clause 1.B), (2) the runtime's provenance, (3) re-signing under clause 2.E remain open.
